# MDC toolbar source fixtures

Original Apache-2.0 sources retain their headers. sources.json records the exact
revision, source URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Generated oracles execute unchanged
Kotlin bodies or ordered XML resource selectors using explicit host adapters.
See tools/androidx-toolbars/README.md for coverage, source choices and limits.
Runtime/browser coverage is recorded in MD3E-PARITY.md; passing this fixture
subset does not establish full Android/Web parity.
